title: What are clouds made of?
examples: Teacher, are clouds made of water?
How do clouds stay up in the sky?
Where does the rain come from?

explain.say: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water.
The drops are so tiny and light that they float in the sky.
The tiny drops join together. When the drops get too heavy, they fall.
When you see a cloud, think of millions of tiny water drops.
A common mistake is to think clouds are soft like cotton wool. Clouds are tiny drops, floating in air.

draw.text: Clouds are tiny drops, not cotton wool.

faq.q: Are clouds made of actual water?
faq.a: Yes. Clouds are made of tiny drops of water, or tiny bits of ice, floating in the air.

faq.q: Why do they float so high up?
faq.a: They float because the water drops are so small and light. Sometimes the air helps them float up to the sky.

faq.q: Does everything that falls from a cloud become rain?
faq.a: Not everything. Sometimes they fall as snow or as little bits of ice. Rain is just one way the water falls.
asks: What else can fall from clouds?

faq.q: Are clouds always in the sky?
faq.a: Clouds are usually high in the sky. A cloud down on the ground is called fog.
asks: Can clouds be on the ground?

faq.q: Do clouds get bigger when they float?
faq.a: Yes, they can get bigger as the tiny drops bump into each other. When they get too big, they fall down.

facts: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets or ice crystals.
Warm, moist air helps these tiny drops float up high.
When the drops combine and get too heavy, they fall as precipitation like rain.
Rain is water that has fallen from the clouds back to Earth.

quiz.show: ☁️ What is a cloud made of?
quiz.why: Clouds are millions of tiny water drops floating in the air.

wrong.0: Clouds look soft, but there is no cotton wool in the sky.
wrong.2: Smoke comes from fires, and clouds are water.

quiz.say: When do the drops fall out of a cloud?
quiz.why: Drops join and grow. When they get too heavy, they fall.

wrong.0: Sunshine dries things up, so it makes no drops fall.
wrong.1: Birds fly past clouds all the time, and the drops stay up.

quiz.say: Water drops fall from a cloud. What do you call them?
quiz.why: Water falling from clouds is called rain.

wrong.1: Steam comes from very hot water, like a kettle.
wrong.2: Mist is a cloud close to the ground.
